en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a calm coastal scene with rocky shoreline, pine trees, small wooden boats, and a log boathouse or shed at the water's edge. Several people, including children and adults, stand on the shore and sit in a rowing boat near a wooden pier. Low buildings are visible across the water in the background. The words "Lovisa." and "Antbystrand" are printed at the bottom.
